notes: extractDifficultyString's switch (line 1416-1422) covers exactly Minecraft's four legacy difficulty integers; any other raw integer (4 here, but the same applies to negatives or anything else out of range) falls to `default: return nil` rather than a placeholder string -- the caller sees 'no difficulty known', identical to the field being absent entirely. Distinct from java-real-modern-format-legacy-fields-absent, where the field is a STRING under a different key altogether and this integer-only extractor never even considers it.
